title: NES
description: NES games on the iDrive (FCEUmm emulator). Comes with two small free games, Snake and Pad Test. Your own .nes files come from a phone (Add games shows a code to scan; needs the NES game loader from this source), from a folder "nes" on a USB stick, or are copied to the head unit. A short main menu; the list of games, Add games and the settings as tabs on one drawn screen, steered by the controller, a USB gamepad or four touch buttons; the game pixel for pixel on the whole screen; BACK returns to the menu and saves. No sound
